# Jackal AI

> AI integration partner for trades and local service businesses, Perth WA. We make your business easier to run: helping you do more, without doing more.

Jackal AI finds where a trade or local service business leaks time and money, then plugs AI into the tools it already uses to fix it. It sells a result, more money and more time back, measured in hours saved per week and dollars recovered or won per month. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute Business Streamlining Consult.

Founded in Perth, WA, Australia in 2024. ABN 92 509 551 334.

## How it works
1. Free Business Streamlining Consult (30 minutes): finds the repetitive jobs, bottlenecks and pointless processes eating the owner's time, walking through how a job moves through the business. The client gets a written plan with the top 3 fixes, what each should save in hours and dollars, and a fixed price for each.
2. First fix, fixed price: the fix that pays back fastest, built into the client's existing tools and tested before it goes live. Starter fixes are $1,500 AUD and Core fixes are $3,000 AUD.
3. AI Partner, month to month: keeps the fixes running, adds more, and sends a monthly report with real numbers.
   - Keep, $495 AUD/month: up to 2 live fixes looked after, about 2 hours of small tweaks a month, a monthly results report and a 30-minute monthly check-in.
   - Grow, $995 AUD/month: up to 5 live fixes, one new small fix each quarter, about 5 hours of tweaks a month, fortnightly check-ins, same-business-day support and a quarterly AI training session for the team.
4. Custom builds (apps, dashboards, websites, bigger integrations): quoted per project at a fixed price with a written scope.

Month to month, no lock-in, no exit fees. Clients own every build, account and login. Nothing goes live without the client's sign-off.

## Fixes across the job cycle
- Enquiries: AI receptionist, missed-call text-back, chat into the job system
- Quotes: quote drafting from notes, automatic follow-up
- Scheduling: booking into the calendar or job system, reminders
- On site: job notes and forms straight into the system
- Invoices: invoice on completion, automatic payment reminders
- After the job: review requests and service reminders (consented SMS/email only)
- Back office: receipt capture into Xero or MYOB, inbox triage, simple dashboards
- Growth: websites built for Google and AI search
- Team: hands-on AI training for owners and staff

## The AI receptionist (one of the fixes)
- Capture: $249 AUD/month + $1,500 one-time setup
- Convert: ~$499 AUD/month + ~$2,750 one-time setup
- Command: ~$999 AUD/month + ~$4,500 one-time setup
- Answers calls 24/7 in a natural Australian voice, captures caller details, books jobs into the calendar, sends SMS and email summaries
- It discloses that it is an AI assistant, and a real person is always reachable
- Details: https://jackalai.app/ai-calls

## Who we serve
Owner-operated trades and home service businesses with 1–20 staff: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, builders, roofers, landscapers, concreters, painters, cleaners, pest control and locksmiths. Also local service businesses with the same admin pain, such as physios and clinics. Perth metro first, then WA and Australia.

## Works with
ServiceM8, Tradify, Fergus, simPRO, Xero, MYOB, Google Calendar, Gmail, Outlook.
